cohort: The study included 412 preterm very low birth weight neonates in Ethiopia.
finding: Only 14.6% of neonates achieved adequate postnatal weight gain at discharge, a figure lower than the national average, with spontaneous vaginal delivery, birth Z-score > -1.29, early feeding initiation, and absence of respiratory distress syndrome being significant positive predictors.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was identified as a significant positive predictor for adequate postnatal weight gain among very low birth weight neonates (AOR: 2.54; 95% CI (1.17, 5.54)).
